process: A man is hand-painting the word victory in black brush strokes, one letter after another, onto a weathered concrete wall.
away_prompt: A bare weathered concrete wall in a dim, quiet space, its grey plaster peeling in patches and stained dark near the floor. Faint drips and dust streaks run down the rough surface. Cool, diffuse light falls from a high window across the texture of the wall. The grey concrete floor is scattered with dust, and the wall continues unbroken to a dark corner under muted, overcast light.

sources.fact: A hand-painted mural is typically finished in about one to two days on site, and a small feature wall under 5 square metres takes about 4 to 6 hours for one artist.

stages.state: Vict painted, t crossbar in progress
stages.prompt: A man in a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Black brush-painted letters spell Vict on the left, and his raised brush is finishing the crossbar of the t. Dark paint drips run down from the letters. Cracked plaster and dark stains mark the lower wall. Soft overcast light.

A man in a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Black brush-painted letters spell Victo across the wall, with the t and o finished and the brush now at the start of the next letter. Dark paint drips run down from the letters. Cracked plaster and dark stains mark the lower wall. Soft overcast light.

A man in a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Black brush-painted letters spell Victor across the wall, with the r stem and arm now painted and the brush moving right. Dark paint drips run down from the letters. Cracked plaster and dark stains mark the lower wall. Soft overcast light.

stages.state: Victory mostly painted, y arms done
stages.prompt: A man in a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Black brush-painted letters spell Victory across the wall, with the y arms painted and its descender being added. Dark paint drips run down from the letters. Cracked plaster and dark stains mark the lower wall. Soft overcast light.

A man in a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, his brush lowered after painting. Black brush-painted letters spell Victory across the weathered grey concrete wall, every letter finished with dried paint drips below. Cracked plaster and dark stains mark the lower wall. Soft overcast light.
